claims: Galatasaray defeated Gençlerbirliği 2-1 on April 18, 2026, in a Süper Lig match at Eryaman Stadyumu.
Galatasaray led 2-0 at halftime against Gençlerbirliği.
Galatasaray stayed at the top of the table after the match.
The venue of the match was Eryaman Stadyumu in Ankara.
Galatasaray has won their last four meetings against Gençlerbirliği
